.²1 A cow, milch-cow; {#DenuM DIrAH sUnftAM vAcamAhuH#} <ls>U. 5. 31</ls>.
.²2 The female of a species (affixed to the names of other animals in this
 sense); as {#KaqgaDenuH, vaqavaDenuH#} <ab>&c.</ab>
.²3 The earth. (Sometimes at the end of <ab>comp.</ab> {#Denu#} forms a diminutive;
 as {#AsiDenuH, KaqgaDenuH#}).
.²4 Any offering or present to Brāhmaṇa instead of or in the shape of
 a cow such as {#guqaDenu, GftaDenu, tilaDenu, jalaDenu, kzIraDenu, maDuDenu#},
 {#SarkarADenu, daDiDenu, rasaDenu, svarUpaDenu#}; <ls>Matsya P.</ls>
.²5 A mare; {#yaTA DenuH kiSoreRa#} <ls>MS. 7. 4. 7</ls>. ({#tadyaTA kfzRakiSorA#}
 {#Denuriti . yadyapi DenuSabdo goDenvAM dfzwapravfttistaTApyaBiDAnasAmAnyAdaSvaDenvAmapi#}
 {#BAgIti kiSoreRa liNgena aSvaDenvAM vijYAyate .#} <ls>ŚB. on MS.</ls>).
(a sacrifice) whereat a cow is given as a fee.

.²1 cowʼs milk.
.²2 a kind of gourd (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>{#cibuqa#}</ns>).
